solves.reasoning: (A) 완벽히 어울리는 가구를 찾아 truly ___ = excited. (B) delay caused ___ inconvenience = considerable. (C) ___ and specific delivery date = clear. excited—considerable—clear.
(A) 가게에서 책장을 ___ a set = purchased. (B) someone would be ___ to receive = available. (C) please ___ a clear date = provide. purchased—available—provide.
(A) furniture perfectly ___ our new home = matched. (B) available to ___ the delivery = receive. (C) addressed ___ = promptly. matched—receive—promptly.
① disappointed가 '완벽히 어울리는 가구를 찾았다'는 긍정 상황과 모순. 원래 excited. manager/delay/specific은 적절.
④ clarity가 'without any ___' 자리에서 어색. 혼란 없이 받으려는 흐름이라 원래 confusion. considerable/provide/expect는 적절.
② clashed가 'perfectly ___ our new home'에서 어색. 어울려서 기뻤다는 흐름이라 원래 matched. purchased/considerable/promptly는 적절.
This delay has caused us considerable ___ : 지연이 준 나쁜 결과 = inconvenience. convenience/excitement/delivery는 부적절.
someone would be ___ to receive the delivery: 받으려면 시간이 되는 = available. absent는 반대, angry/asleep 부적절.
a clear and ___ delivery date: clear와 나란히 정확함 강조 = specific. vague 반대, random/hidden 부적절.
purchased=구입했다 → bought. returned/rented/borrowed 뜻 다름.
considerable=상당한 → significant. tiny 반대, equal/rising 뜻 다름.
promptly=신속히 → quickly. rarely/loudly/secretly 뜻 다름.
excited=신이 난 반대 → bored. thrilled는 동의어 함정, curious/proud 의미축 다름.
clear=분명한 반대 → vague. obvious/plain 동의어 함정, bright 의미축 다름.
(A) a set of bookshelves = (한) 세트, (B) had set our plans = 계획을 세우다.
물건을 보내는 곳까지 가져다주는 과정 = delivery. schedule/manager/store 부적절.
This delay has ___ (cause): has 뒤 과거분사(현재완료) → caused.
this issue to be ___ (address): to be 뒤 과거분사(수동) → addressed.
so that we can ___ to receive the delivery: 정확한 날짜를 알아 일정을 다시 짬 → reorganize our schedule. 나머지는 배송 수령 흐름과 무관.
to ensure ___ to receive the delivery: 받을 사람이 있어야 함 → someone would be available. 나머지는 배송 수령 준비와 무관.
